note: The county statement of votes cast for the 2010 general election lists every contest on the ballot and includes no Stockton mayoral contest. The county's June 2010 statement of votes cast also lists no Stockton mayoral contest. Stockton mayoral elections fall in 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2024, a four-year cycle, so this year is not a mayoral election year.

The San Joaquin County Registrar of Voters index of statements of votes cast lists every election the county ran. It shows no regular Stockton election in this year; the only Stockton-specific odd-year election, in November 2013, covered Measures A and B only and had no mayoral contest. Stockton mayoral elections fall in even years on a four-year cycle (2012, 2016, 2020, 2024).

The San Joaquin County Registrar of Voters statement of votes cast records a Stockton mayoral contest in the 2012 general election. Stockton elects its mayor by majority in the primary or in a runoff at the general election; the county's primary statement of votes cast shows that no candidate won a majority in the primary, so the general election decided the office. The primary is an earlier round and is not recorded separately. Winner and runner-up are in stockton_results.json.
